probes.reading: literal

Physical-null serialization reading of citation 1 (Otherwise CQ01NAM=NULL): retain the literal spaced SOC text and exact exclusion membership, using physical null rather than SAS empty text for the unpopulated branch.

Typographic reading of citation 1: join the internal space in SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS, retaining every other documented clause, including exact full-term exclusions and SAS empty text otherwise. The document itself supplies no corrected SOC spelling.

Combined typographic and physical-null reading of citation 1: join the internal SUBC UTANEOUS space and serialize its Otherwise CQ01NAM=NULL branch as physical null, retaining exact full-term exclusions.

interpretations: The literal SOC comparison preserves every character inside the documented quoted text. The joined-word reading is an explicitly proposed correction, not another retained-document statement.
The contains test is case sensitive because the method gives uppercase strings and no case conversion. No synonym expansion, spelling repair, or dictionary recoding is added.

The exact not-in predicate treats an unpopulated preferred term as outside the listed nonmissing exclusions. Physical null is therefore handled explicitly as outside the list, consistent with the empty SAS-character reading; no missing-term rejection is stated.

NULL is an unpopulated character field for the primary probe. Input empty_string: present preserves SAS empty text; the separate physical-null probes retain the serialization ambiguity without changing the positive assignment.
The probe reads the published REF.AEDECOD and REF.AEBODSYS through stable helper aliases; it does not propagate any local source-copy calculation.
